title: ESGPT: A Data-Centric ESG Language Model with Unified Instruction and Benchmark Resources
abstract: arXiv:2611.30052v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: ESG analysis requires complex language understanding across diverse sources, including corporate reports, news, and disclosures, for tasks such as ESG relevance detection, action interpretation, impact analysis, and question answering. However, existing ESG datasets are fragmented by task and source, with heterogeneous formats and annotation schemes, limiting their use for training general-purpose ESG LLMs and unified evaluation. In this work, we construct ESG-Instruct, a 30,000-instance ESG instruction dataset built from public ESG resources, and ESGU-Bench, an ESG understanding benchmark covering six representative ESG tasks. translated_title: ESGPT：具有统一指令与基准资源的以数据为中心的ESG语言模型
translated_abstract: ESG（环境、社会与治理）分析需要对包括企业报告、新闻和信息披露在内的多种来源进行复杂的语言理解，以完成ESG相关性检测、行为解读、影响分析和问答等任务。然而，现有的ESG数据集在任务和来源上较为分散，格式与标注方案各异，这限制了它们在训练通用ESG大语言模型以及进行统一评估方面的应用。在本研究中，我们构建了ESG-Instruct——一个基于公开ESG资源构建、包含3万条实例的ESG指令数据集，以及ESGU-Bench——一个涵盖六项代表性ESG任务的ESG理解基准。基于这些资源，我们进一步开发了ESGPT——一个80亿参数的ESG专用大语言模型，并将其与多种开源及基于API的大语言模型进行对比评估。实验结果表明，通用大语言模型在不同ESG任务上的表现存在显著差异，而ESGPT尽管规模相对较小，仍取得了（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该研究构建了包含3万条实例的ESG指令数据集ESG-Instruct和覆盖六项代表性任务的基准ESGU-Bench，并据此训练出80亿参数的ESG专用大语言模型ESGPT，其以较小的规模在多项ESG任务上超越了表现参差不齐的通用大语言模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ESG-Instruct (a 30,000-instance ESG instruction dataset), ESGU-Bench (a benchmark covering six representative ESG tasks), and ESGPT, an 8B ESG-specialized LLM that outperforms general-purpose LLMs across diverse ESG tasks despite its relatively small scale.
